categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in mission-critical communication (MCC) solutions, including network access equipment, optical communication devices, IP transmission equipment, and integrated network management systems. It serves primarily the power, government, telecommunications, and transportation sectors with a focus on high-reliability communication networks. The product portfolio includes TDM, SDH/SONET, PTN, MPLS-TP, and 5G transmission equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs FPGA-based designs for flexible and customizable network equipment, integrating TDM and IP technologies for hybrid transmission solutions. It develops high-capacity optical fiber transmission systems supporting STM-16/OC-48 and PTN with up to 100G bandwidth. The company also incorporates advanced network management software with AI and cybersecurity features, adhering to international standards like ISO27001, IEC62443, and FIPS 140-3. Production follows ISO9001 standards with rigorous hardware and software integration and testing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include power utilities, government agencies, telecommunications operators, transportation sectors such as railways and airports, and emerging markets in developing countries. The company’s products are widely used in mission-critical networks requiring high reliability and security. Approximately 80% of revenue comes from power and government sectors, with telecommunications and transportation accounting for about 15%. Major markets include the Americas, Europe, Taiwan, and emerging regions like Southeast Asia and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with business in 45 countries, focusing on the Americas, Europe, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. Its headquarters and manufacturing are located in Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan, with offices in Taipei and Tainan. Subsidiaries and investments exist in the British Virgin Islands, Hong Kong, China (Tianjin and Chongqing), and the United States (Texas).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the telecommunications supply chain, designing, manufacturing, and integrating network transmission equipment and management systems. It also provides ODM/OEM services to international system integrators and equipment manufacturers, positioning itself as a solutions provider rather than just a component supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing the G7800 platform with higher bandwidth and enhanced security modules, developing hybrid TDM/IP transmission modules, expanding enterprise and government cybersecurity solutions, and integrating IIoT and OT security devices. The company invests heavily in R&D (~24% of revenue), focusing on AI-enabled network management, zero packet loss algorithms, and compliance with international cybersecurity standards. Future R&D targets include 600G control cards, MACsec/IPsec encryption, and 5G CPE devices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of communication transmission equipment and network management systems. The company also earns maintenance and service fees from international customers and system integrators. ODM and OEM contracts with global partners contribute to revenue, alongside sales of cybersecurity and AI-integrated solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global telecommunications equipment giants such as ABB, Siemens, Nokia (Alcatel-Lucent), Cisco, and Huawei. The company differentiates itself through vertical integration, proprietary FPGA technology, and a strong focus on mission-critical communication markets. It holds a niche position with a reputation for reliability and customization, aiming to become a top-three player in the public utility MCC transmission market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$650 million with a net profit of NT$209 million in the latest fiscal year, showing stable growth and a gross margin above 60%. It maintains a strong financial structure with improving profitability ratios and efficient asset turnover. R&D expenditure is consistently around 24% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation. The company has about 159 employees with an average service of 12 years, indicating a stable workforce.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, low latency, and zero packet loss in mission-critical communication networks, supported by proprietary FPGA designs and advanced hybrid TDM/IP solutions. Its products comply with stringent international cybersecurity certifications, offering integrated AI-driven network management and security. Customization capabilities, vertical integration, and a comprehensive product portfolio from access to core network layers provide customers with flexible, scalable, and secure communication solutions tailored to critical infrastructure needs.
